run_state_at_capture: in progress; mid-run observation, not a completed or validated transport run
dashboard_scope: Web console redesign rendering actual live observations of the same run. The API read only dashboard-state.json and actions.jsonl without --commands-dir, so no run control was available or used. Vehicle, cargo and inventory shapes are ledger-based schematics; robot motion between 1.5 s polls is tweened for display only.
renderer: headless Chromium 1208 with SwiftShader WebGL, viewport 1440x900, deviceScaleFactor 1; PNG converted to JPEG (ffmpeg -q:v 3)
selection: carter1 selected from the vehicle list; camera moved by the list click
